Brief: Tell me about the Hubble Space Telescope and what it has discovered. — about Cosmic Assembly Near-infrared Deep Extragalactic Legacy Survey

1. In an August 2013 press release, CANDELS was referred to as "the largest project in the history of Hubble".
2. The CANDELS project site describes the survey's goals as the following: The Cosmic Assembly Near-IR Deep Extragalactic Legacy Survey is designed to document the first third of galactic evolution from z = 8 to 1.5 via deep imaging of more than 250,000 galaxies with WFC3/IR and ACS.
3. It will also find the first Type Ia SNe beyond z > 1.5 and establish their accuracy as standard candles for cosmology.
4. Five premier multi-wavelength sky regions are selected; each has multi-wavelength data from Spitzer and other facilities, and has extensive spectroscopy of the brighter galaxies.
5. The use of five widely separated fields mitigates cosmic variance and yields statistically robust and complete samples of galaxies down to 109 solar masses out to z ~ 8.
